criteria.text: A guidance-only PR 1 can be explicitly approved with an intentionally reviewed empty prompt selection, and its later code choice waits for a separate approval.

After a change request invalidates that review and merged PR 1 completes the run, `pdd workflow done try` from its worktree displays and durably saves the current code-choice review, including an empty selection, without approving, publishing, allocating a chat or changing progress.

After that current review is shown, a later explicit scoped approval starts the normal validated code continuation once, preserving the original run, PR-1 identity, publication head, owned paths, prior progress and approval evidence. After the code decision is saved, PR 1 refreshes its description and saved readable facts with the current approval and PR state.
An absent review refuses approval even when no prompts are selected; stale or revoked reviews and substantive prompt changes still require a current review and new approval.
Cancelled runs and runs completed in code remain ended; attempting review recovery or approval cannot start code, change progress or add approval evidence.

native_boundary: Real bin/pdd.mjs workflow commands; temporary Git repository and local bare origin; deterministic executable gh/Herdr transports. No Runtime, model, live publication or real agent.

cases.given: Synthetic guidance-only change with no prompt files; prompt-pr check complete and try skipped through CLI.
cases.approval_input: Synthetic fixture: approve this reviewed guidance PR1 only.

cases.given: Previous case; deliver a nonapproval change request through CLI, then fake remote reports merged PR 1.
commands: Prepare the bounded local verification plan; this is not code approval.
cases.approval_input: Synthetic fixture: approve code after current review.

cases.given: Previous case, retaining the original missing review and existing PR-1 approval.
commands: Show current code-choice review; do not approve.

cases.given: Previous case after review display; independently supply a later explicit approval through stdin.
cases.approval_input: Synthetic fixture: approve this current code continuation only.

expected.code_base: fetched saved base after PR 1 merge

cases.given: Independent ready-gate worlds: absent empty review, absent nonempty review, stale digest, changed selected path, changed prompt prose, and delivered change revoking a previously shown review.
cases.approval_input: Synthetic fixture approval attempt; missing current review must refuse.

cases.given: Independent cancelled ask-code and completed-code worlds; invoke recovery and approval separately from each unchanged starting world.
cases.approval_input: Synthetic fixture approval attempt; ended run must refuse.

cases.given: Independent ordinary ready prompt/code flow; strict supplied-approval refusal; wrong-run selection; missing config; and cancellation or gate replacement between selection and save.
cases.expected: Ordinary eligible flow keeps its existing outcome. Each invalid approval/recovery preserves the latest run and prior evidence, records no decision and causes no publication, branch or chat effect. A stale invocation cannot refresh or revive a replacement/cancelled run.
